title: North Approach Plaza
summary: A broad paved plaza at the northern apex of the village. Ahead, the massive iron-and-brass bulkhead of the military fortress looms over the road, sealed shut. Two heavily-armed garrison guards stand sentry before the reinforced gates.
inspect_text: Steam pipes run along high stone pylons to heat the open plaza. Two stern garrison sentries stand watch before the sealed brass bulkhead with ready steam crossbows, permitting no one to pass.
feature_inspect: A towering bulkhead of banded iron and riveted brass, bolted firmly from within. There is no exterior handle, and the sentries ensure nobody approaches.

title: Clockmaker's Terrace
summary: A stone terrace lined with workbenches and brass fittings. The air clicks and hums with miniature clockwork gears and steam escapements.
inspect_text: Tariq's open-air clockwork studio overlooks the terraced village. Glass cabinets house brass calipers, gear trains, and intricate timing mechanisms.
feature_inspect: A sturdy wooden workbench covered in jeweler's loupes, brass cogwheels, fine tweezers, and sketches of intricate escapements.

title: Wash Basin Terrace
summary: A communal stone terrace lined with laundry tubs fed by warm condensed-water pipes from the central boiler.
inspect_text: Lines of heavy canvas work-shirts and overalls hang drying in warm air rising from floor grates. Clear, warm water drains into low limestone gutters.
feature_inspect: A long zinc-lined stone trough filled with warm steaming water, scrubbed clean by generations of miners' families.

title: Water Spring Terrace
summary: A tranquil corner where cold subterranean springs bubble from living rock into tiered stone basins.
inspect_text: Villagers fill brass canteens and wooden buckets. Overhead copper pipes radiate gentle warmth to keep the damp terrace comfortable.
feature_inspect: A natural moss-edged hollow in limestone overflowing with cold, clear drinking water.

title: South Weavers' Lane
summary: A quiet residential lane flanked by low limestone dwellings with colorful woven carpets hung over doorframes.
inspect_text: Children's wooden toys sit on stone doorsteps. The smell of cedar shavings and mint tea drifts from open windows.
feature_inspect: Thick dyed wool carpets woven in geometric lozenge patterns that protect homes from cavern drafts.

title: Lantern Makers' Alley
summary: A stone alley where copper sheets and mica panes are fitted into the protective lanterns used throughout the underground.
inspect_text: Scores of unlit oil and luminescent lanterns hang from drying racks above the cobblestones.
feature_inspect: A timber framework laden with heavy brass frames and faceted mica lenses designed to withstand coal dust and damp.

title: South Overlook Terrace
summary: A high stone parapet at the southeastern tip of the village, looking down into the deep subterranean abyss.
inspect_text: A low stone wall keeps children safe from the drop. Lanterns flicker along the railing, casting long shadows into the cavern vastness.
feature_inspect: Solid limestone blocks cut with drainage scuppers, polished smooth by generations of leaning villagers.

title: Terrace of the Dried Herbs
summary: A warm stone walkway fragrant with the pungent scent of subterranean mosses and drying cave rosemary.
inspect_text: Bundles of sage and medicinal fungi hang from overhead copper steam lines to cure in the steady heat.
feature_inspect: Neatly bundled sprigs of dark cavern rosemary and cured amber lichen prized for soothing burns.

title: North Terrace Gardens
summary: Tiered planter boxes cut from the cavern floor, glowing with phosphorescent green and blue lichen.
inspect_text: Carefully tended moisture trays nurture edible mushrooms and small sweet subterranean root vegetables.
feature_inspect: Carved limestone planters filled with rich compost and glowing moss providing soft blue illumination.

title: The Village Square
summary: The beating heart of the village. A broad circular plaza paved in concentric stone rings, surrounded by warm gas lamps.
inspect_text: At the center, broad spiral stone stairs lead UP to the Floor 3 Heart-Pit ('oh'). A large iron hearth warms the gathering villagers.
feature_inspect: Solid granite stairs ascending into the dark ceiling toward Floor 3.

title: Elder Rashid's Quarters
summary: A modest stone house lined with bookshelves, maps of the cavern system, and brass surveying instruments.
inspect_text: Elder Rashid sits here at a heavy oak desk, head in his hands, surrounded by official military decrees and the requisition roll for Zayd.
feature_inspect: A parchment document bearing Captain Malik's iron seal, demanding one youth as an offering.

title: Yasmin's Bakery
summary: A warm, flour-dusted bakery smelling wonderfully of fresh flatbread, sesame, and roasted dates.
inspect_text: A huge brick oven heated by copper steam coils dominates the back. Yasmin stands by the counter, tearful and furious over Zayd's capture.
feature_inspect: A massive domed brick hearth with steam pipes wrapping its base, baking scores of flatbreads.
